'''Quantum fields''' was an area of science.

Scientists were still researching quantum fields as of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], but its research was considered a dangerous practice. [[Sneevel/Legends|Sneevel]] experts, who were attracted by dangerous practices, excelled at it.
